queries_run: Strategy MSTR business model transition software cloud subscription on-premises end of support 2026

findings.claim: Strategy 10-K FY2025: 分析平台提供地端授權或雲端訂閱；自2025年1月起地端授權進入end-of-support週期，完整支援於2026-12-31結束；雲端訂閱通常36個月；通路夥伴持續為銷售與服務覆蓋。
findings.excerpt: We offer our analytics platform in the form of an on-premises product license or a cloud subscription; however, as of January 2025, Strategy on-premises product licenses have entered an end-of-support cycle, with full support for such licenses ending December 31, 2026. Subscriptions for cloud-based deployments typically are for 36 months and include standard support.

findings.claim: Strategy支援生命週期頁：地端主流支援至2026-12-31，延伸支援至2028-12-31。

note: 僅軟體業務有雲端轉移；搜尋未見D2C/平台化通路破壞證據。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
